attr.title: Runner Protocol
attr.desc: An extraction game played against your own real Claude Code usage limits. Every 5-hour usage window is a run: salvage accrues while you work, a multiplier peaks in the productive band, and you must EXTRACT to bank it before the window burns out or blacks out. Live data arrives from an optional companion pusher on your PC; without one, the built-in PROTOCOL DRILL plays a full synthetic run so every mechanic works out of the box. Original game, code and artwork by the author. Requires a 640x480 32bpp framebuffer (ArkOS on RK3326-class devices).
attr.inst: Ready to run. For live data, run the companion pusher from the project page on your PC. Without it, press Y on the NO SIGNAL screen to play the synthetic PROTOCOL DRILL.
